claim_B.reason: Zero trace of two positive factors forces support inclusion; after pure-site factorization all retained/replaced branch supports on the mixed-marginal block are orthogonal. The pure factors satisfy the binary-error bound even above error probability one half.

corollary.scope: For each fixed finite tuple (n,d,psi,tau), some q0>0 works. No uniform q0 is established.
